rule: PMF normalization, finite calibration and STIT choice partitions
meaning: On the fixed ChanceRival history frame, every positive normalized binary pair completes the qualitative description; positive support, strict probability ranking and tied optimality do not uniquely determine the law. A singleton calibration or complete binary exchange symmetry uniquely determines it; one two-element orbit and a singleton do not. Identical histories can support either effective STIT control of creation and withholding or indiscrete cells without that control. These are diagnostic mathematical controls, not a proof that a fixed complete essence permits variable intrinsic propensities or that intention guarantees sufficient reason.
